name: Kibō: Slow Fall
source:
The Kibō project will hopefully be a serie of several arcs. It's an RPG with NSFW content made with RPGM. In this serie, you will incarn and revive a young couple's life in a modern city full of corruption. Will they resist? Will they stay together? Will they both fall? I guess you have an idea what's coming down with the title.

The story begins with a conversation remembering what happened at a time when the couple was... Different... All of this arc, is in the past.

For this first arc, Slow Fall, I will take our couple down a mental challenging road. I am mainly focused on 3 characters surrounding John (You can rename him) right now:
- Jane (You can rename her), the wife, a real brunette beauty with big boobs.
- Emilie, Jane's best friend, a cute little fancy one with some temper.
- Anna, the secretary, a hot-headed dark hair with dominant vibes.

Will they help him or not? Depend what is your definition of help...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/dscorruptionnovels]Patreon[/url]]
